layouts.name: Ruapuna
layouts.description: Combined Grand Prix, Dipper, outer and Eastern configurations. Four exact OSM routes and one independently digitized image route. Coordinate-distinct overlapping paths remain separate in the mapped branch length; this is not one lap.

layouts.name: Grand Prix
layouts.description: The federation circuit map identifies the full Grand Prix branch sequence, including the Western technical return and central Northern U. Its independent 3282.1 m measured distance differs from the published 3.33 km. Fine corner alignment and direction remain draft.

layouts.name: Grand Prix with dipper
layouts.description: The operator test-day rules explicitly distinguish the motorcycle Grand Prix with dipper. This route retains the Southern central dipper and every Grand Prix branch. Independent measured length is 3387.5 m; alignment remains draft.

layouts.name: Outer course with dipper
layouts.description: A draft component of the operator multi-configuration facility: the complete Western outer return, central shortcut and Eastern loop with the Southern dipper. Branch names are descriptive, not homologation labels. Exact independent mapped distance is 2287.8 m.

layouts.name: Outer course
layouts.description: A draft component retaining the complete Western outer return, central shortcut and Eastern loop, without the dipper. Branch names are descriptive, not homologation labels. Exact independent mapped distance is 2182.4 m.

layouts.name: Eastern course
layouts.description: Draft short Eastern course independently digitized from March 2025 LINZ aerial imagery. Northern return junction corrected; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: This general entry represents the combined Grand Prix, dipper, Western outer and short Eastern course branches. The federation 3.33 km map establishes Grand Prix identity and the operator test rules establish the dipper variant. The operator identifies six configurations at the facility. Branch geometry comes only from one pinned independent snapshot; no comparison-image vertices are copied. Northern pit-access roads, the adjacent dirt speedway and the new 2026 duplicate course way are excluded. Descriptive component names and historical alignments remain provisional. The independent unique branch distance is 3731.7 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.

sources.title: Aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates. Source-specific extraction and derived-coordinate redistribution agreement confirmed by the dataset operator; agreement held separately. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.

sources.title: LINZ Christchurch 0.075 m Urban Aerial Photos (2025)
sources.evidenceNote: Environment Canterbury; imagery by Aerial Surveys, captured March 2025; hosted and processed by Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, CC BY 4.0. Reprojected, cropped and sampled by OpenRacetrackDB. Native 0.075 m imagery resampled at 0.2 m ground spacing. Tile metadata, checksums and exact reprojection extent retained in sources/research/ruapuna-eastern-route-correction.json.

sources.title: Ruapuna mixed-source component network
sources.evidenceNote: Four independently pinned OSM routes plus an Eastern route digitized from LINZ imagery. Actual coordinate-source IDs are attached to the public trace. Each component trace and snapshot is hash pinned; no coordinate snapping or invented connecting edges.
